evals.prompt: Review /Users/mm25zamanian/Codes/rasta-company.com/Dockerfile and produce a best-practice nginx-cdn Dockerfile. Keep the static build inside Docker, use the latest compatible SemVer versions without digests, set five-minute cache defaults, disable compression, and explain the health contract.
evals.expected_output: A multi-stage Dockerfile review that preserves the static Next export, uses nginx-cdn, applies the requested runtime policy, and identifies validation commands.
assertions: Keeps the application build in the Dockerfile and does not add a duplicate workflow artifact build.
Uses a full SemVer nginx-cdn tag without latest or digest syntax.
Sets five-minute cache policy including hashed assets, gzip off, expires off, service-worker no-cache, and error no-store.
Explains /server-info or inherited health behavior and gives build plus origin verification commands.

evals.prompt: Audit /Users/mm25zamanian/Codes/fara-list/Dockerfile. Decide whether nginx-cdn or nginx-spa fits the Vite application, identify the duplicated build risk with its deploy workflow, and propose the smallest safe Dockerfile structure.
evals.expected_output: A routing decision that keeps SPA fallback on nginx-spa, identifies duplicate application builds, and proposes a reproducible multi-stage structure.
assertions: Recognizes client-side routing and selects or retains nginx-spa rather than weakening nginx-cdn 404 behavior.
Identifies that the workflow and Dockerfile both build the application.
Preserves SemVer-only image and package references without latest or digest syntax.
Reports project-specific environment and verification assumptions instead of inventing unsupported variables.

evals.prompt: Modernize /Users/mm25zamanian/Codes/gecut.ir/Dockerfile for the current nginx-cdn consumer contract. Detect the legacy image name, remove unsafe long cache and compression settings, and return an implementation-ready review.
evals.expected_output: A migration-focused review that replaces the legacy image reference and restores the controlled short-cache, compression-off runtime policy.
assertions: Flags ghcr.io/gecut/nginx:0.0.0-cdn as legacy and selects a SemVer nginx-cdn image.
Removes or replaces long-lived expires/cache settings and turns gzip and gzip Vary off.
Keeps static artifact ownership correct and does not add a Node runtime to the final stage.
Includes a health, build, NGINX configuration, and origin smoke verification path.

evals.prompt: Write a production Dockerfile for a pnpm static site with a dist/ output on ghcr.io/gecut/nginx/cdn. Use a cache-efficient multi-stage build, latest compatible stable SemVer dependencies without SHAs, short cache defaults, disabled compression, and a basic health contract.
evals.expected_output: A complete Dockerfile plus concise rationale and verification checklist.
assertions: Uses manifest-first dependency caching, frozen lockfile installation, and a separate builder stage.
Copies only dist/ into /data with nginx ownership and uses a SemVer nginx-cdn final image.
Disables gzip and expires, sets short cache defaults, and preserves service-worker/error safety.
Does not use latest, digest syntax, unsupported variables, or an unnecessary runtime server.
